minor.issue: When category_id filter is applied, the rank re-assignment loop at server.py:5611-5613 does `r = dict(r); r['rank'] = i` which only mutates a local shallow copy and never writes back to the list. With current data (only 1 ranked provider, already rank 1) the bug is invisible; but as soon as e.g. provider B with rank=3 is the only one in the filtered category, the response will still show rank=3 instead of rank=1. Latent bug — recommend fix: `rows[i-1] = {**r, 'rank': i}` or build a new list.

action_items: (MINOR / latent) Fix rank re-assignment in GET /api/leaderboard/monthly when category_id is provided — currently a shallow-copy bug at server.py:5611-5613 that doesn't write back. Not user-visible today (only 1 ranked provider) but will surface as soon as a filtered subset starts at a non-1 original rank.
critical_code_review_comments: _compute_leaderboard correctly filters PUBLIC_GUARD + is_active + verification_status='approved' — verified 0 TEST_ rows and 0 zero-score rows in response.
Score formula matches the public formula exactly; verified by computing expected = sum(field*weight) for María's breakdown and asserting equality to row.score.
Sort key (-score, -rating, -reviews_count) correct and ranks assigned sequentially starting at 1.

Caching path is in-process module dict — fine for single-pod deploy but will diverge across replicas if backend ever scales horizontally. Acceptable for current scale; note for future. 5-min TTL gives recent-enough scores while keeping aggregate cost down.

LATENT BUG: category_id filter at lines 5611-5613 reassigns local `r = dict(r); r['rank'] = i` but never writes the modified dict back into the list — so filtered responses keep original (un-filtered) ranks. Hidden by current demo (only 1 row total, already rank 1). High-priority before launch when more categories accumulate rows.

/api/leaderboard/me correctly returns 403 for non-providers and never leaks other providers' user_ids in the top_10 fields (each row includes only public-safe slug/business_name/photo_url/etc — same shape as /monthly).
Frontend RankingPage handles ranked-count<3 gracefully by rendering empty <div /> for missing podium slots — verified visually (only #1 present, slots #2 and #3 absent, no crash).
LeaderboardWidget on ProviderDashboard renders 3 breakdown chips only for non-zero scoring fields — clean conditional rendering, no '0 pts X' clutter.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end. Latent bug noted in category_id filter rank rewrite (shallow-copy not written back); not reproducible with current 1-row seed but will surface as soon as a filtered subset's first row has original rank > 1. Recommended one-line fix: replace `r = dict(r); r['rank'] = i` with `rows[i-1] = {**rows[i-1], 'rank': i}` inside the enumerate loop.
